evidence: Three in situ analysis techniques consisting of x-ray diffraction, elastic light scattering, and resistance analysis were used to determine the diffusion barrier failure temperature of Ta films. The same analyses were performed on bilayer structures of Cu/physical-vapor-deposition Ta films with comparable thicknesses. The properties of the grown Ta films were analyzed by various techniques including Rutherford backscattering (RBS), x-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and four-point-probe resistivity measurements.
